challenges.name: end-of-day-delivery-summary
challenges.title: End-of-day delivery summary
challenges.description: The drivers' handhelds export the day's deliveries as a CSV: parcel_id,route,weight_g,cod_vnd,status. Write parse_row(line: &str) -> Result<Delivery, String>, which trims every field and rejects a row with the exact messages from the task (wrong field count, empty parcel_id or route, bad weight_g, bad cod_vnd, unknown status), and add(totals: &mut RouteTotals, delivery: &Delivery), which counts parcels, weight, delivered and failed parcels, and the cash on delivery collected (delivered) or still open (failed). The test runner skips the header and blank lines, groups the rows per route in a BTreeMap and prints the summary, the failed parcels and every rejected line with its line number.
